# Performance Optimizations and Edge Case Tests for FC-Events

## PR Context
- **Devin Run**: This PR was created and reviewed using Devin AI. [View the Devin run](https://preview.devin.ai/devin/b5aa75150f0c4eaf97dc4781c51b1500)
- **Reviewer**: @Mendel

This pull request includes performance optimizations and comprehensive edge case tests for the FC-Events project. Below are the detailed changes made to the existing files in the main branch and the reasons for these changes:

## Changes to Existing Files

### `index.html`
- **Data Attributes Update**: Updated `data-filter` attributes to use valid JSON format with double quotes to ensure compatibility with JavaScript parsing logic.
- **Structural Adjustments**: Made minor structural adjustments to ensure consistency and functionality across different browsers.
- **Icon Integration**: Added Font Awesome icons to improve the visual presentation of program details.

### `scripts.js`
- **Utility Function Enhancement**: Improved the `generateFilterValue` function with better error handling and logging for debugging purposes.
- **DOM Caching**: Implemented caching of frequently accessed DOM elements to reduce repeated queries and improve performance.
- **Efficient Category Lookup**: Created a Map for category data, allowing for faster lookups when processing program categories.
- **Optimized DOM Manipulations**: Utilized DocumentFragment for batch DOM updates, significantly reducing reflows and repaints.
- **Enhanced Filtering Logic**: Improved the `filterPrograms` function to ensure programs are only visible if they match all selected audience filters, enhancing the accuracy of the filtering functionality.
- **Logging Improvements**: Added extensive console logging for better debugging and performance monitoring.

## New Additions

### Cypress Tests
- **Basic Functionality Tests**: Added `basic.cy.js` to cover key functionalities such as loading the main page, program categorization, audience and day-based filtering, program details expansion, and active filter display and removal.
- **Edge Case Tests**: Added `edge_cases.cy.js` to cover edge cases including multiple filter combinations, boundary conditions for date-based filters, scenarios with no matching results, performance with a large number of events, and input validation and error handling.

### Configuration and Setup
- **Cypress Configuration**: Created `cypress.config.js` to configure the Cypress test runner with appropriate settings for the FC-Events project.
- **Babel Setup**: Added `babel.config.js` to enable ES6 code transformation, ensuring compatibility with modern JavaScript features.
- **Package.json Updates**: Updated `package.json` with new scripts and dependencies for running tests and Cypress.

## Reasons for Changes

- **Improved Performance**: The optimizations in `scripts.js` are aimed at reducing unnecessary DOM manipulations and enhancing the responsiveness of the application, especially on lower-end devices.
- **Enhanced Test Coverage**: The addition of Cypress tests ensures comprehensive coverage of both basic functionalities and edge cases, improving the robustness and reliability of the FC-Events project.
- **Compatibility and Consistency**: Updates to `index.html` and the use of Babel ensure consistent behavior across different browsers and environments.
- **Better Debugging**: The added logging in `scripts.js` will help in identifying and resolving issues more quickly during development and testing.

## Testing Instructions

Please thoroughly test the following functionality to ensure no regressions:
1. Category filtering
2. Audience and day filtering
3. Program details expansion
4. Active filter display and removal
5. Performance with a large number of programs
6. Edge case scenarios as covered in the new Cypress tests

## Next Steps

- Consider implementing lazy loading for program details to further improve initial load times.
- Explore the possibility of using virtual scrolling for large program lists.
- Implement server-side filtering if the number of programs becomes too large for efficient client-side filtering.

Your review and feedback are appreciated. Let's discuss any concerns or suggestions for further improvements.


If you have any feedback, you can leave comments in the PR and I'll address them in the app!

body: This pull request modifies the `_header_cell` function in the `changelog_generator/views/table.py` file. author: elviskahoro
body: This pull request refactors the OpenAI client initialization in the backend. It renames the global variable from `_client` to `CLIENT_OPEN_AI` for better clarity and consistency with naming conventions. The `get_openai_client()` function is updated to use this new variable name. Additionally, the OpenAI client initialization is now more explicit, with the API key passed as a named parameter.

author: elviskahoro
body:
This pull request implements functionality to fetch GitHub pull requests between two specified tags. Key changes include:

1. Added a GitHub client initialization function using the GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable.
2. Implemented a new background task `fetch_pull_requests_between_tags` to retrieve pull requests between two given tags.
3. Updated the `GithubPullRequest` model to include relevant fields for pull request data.
4. Modified the table view to display pull request information instead of customer data.
5. Removed unused components and imports related to the previous customer data display.
6. Added PyGithub to the requirements.txt file for GitHub API integration.

These changes enable the application to fetch and display relevant pull request data for changelog generation.

author: daaaav
body:
This extension translates the webhook messages according to the UI language of the user who is making the change. This may not always be correct - the wiki I edit and the connected Discord server are fully in English, but since I have the wiki's interface language set to my native language, the webhook messages were being sent with the translations hard-baked into them to an English-speaking community.

![notenglish](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9ea60f3f-c09a-4db0-9027-d505ddefc85e)

This PR adds `->inContentLanguage()` to all the `wfMessage()`s so the webhook messages will be in the same language as the wiki content. (See https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Manual:Messages_API#Language)

author: elviskahoro
body:
This pull request renames variables and methods related to email content generation to more accurately reflect their purpose in generating changelogs. Specifically:

1. The `email_content_data` variable has been renamed to `changelog_content_data`.
2. The `generate_email` method has been renamed to `generate_changelog`.

These changes improve code clarity and better represent the functionality of generating changelogs rather than emails.
